summary: גָּוַע describes the death of a person or an animal. In the flood account it first predicts the death of creatures that have the breath of life and then records their deaths.

senses.definition: To die, of a person or an animal.

evidence.note: After announcing that the flood will destroy all flesh with the breath of life, God says that everything on earth will perish.
וַיִּגְוַע describes what happened to the animals and humans on the earth. The next verse says that all on dry land with the breath of life מֵתוּ, ‘died’.
